Pour the salsa mixture over everything, then add half the Monterey Jack cheese. Add the remaining tortilla strips and top with the rest of the cheese.
Cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours or high for 3-4 hours, until chicken is cooked through and everything is hot and bubbly.
Stir in the cilantro and parsley in the last 15 minutes of cooking.
Serve hot with Spanish rice on the side.

d: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Pasta is a slow-cooked delight that features tender chicken breasts infused with rich butter, aromatic garlic, and fresh rosemary. The juicy cherry tomatoes and colorful red peppers create a vibrant and flavorful sauce that beautifully coats the pasta. This dish is not just a meal; it’s a comforting embrace on a plate that will leave you craving every last bite!
dir: Place chicken breasts in the crockpot and season with salt and pepper. Add butter, garlic, onion, red peppers, rosemary, and cherry tomatoes on top.
Cook on low for 6-7 hours or high for 3-4 hours until chicken is fully cooked and tender.
Remove chicken and shred with two forks. Return shredded chicken to the crockpot.
Add cream cheese, sour cream, parmesan cheese, lemon juice, and boiled potatoes. Stir everything together until cream cheese is melted and sauce is smooth.
Add cooked angel hair pasta to the crockpot and toss everything together until well combined.
Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve hot with extra parmesan on the side.

d: Pepperoni and Sausage Pizza Dip is a mouthwatering appetizer that combines spicy Italian sausage, pepperoni, and gooey cream cheese for a pizza lover’s dream come true. The addition of marinara sauce and melted Parmesan cheese creates a luscious, savory dip perfect for scooping with crunchy chips. Dive into this cheesy, decadent treat that’s sure to impress at your next party!
i: 1 lb Jimmy Dean hot Italian sausage
1½ cups marinara sauce or vodka sauce
8 oz fresh mozzarella, torn into pieces
Papa John's garlic sauce for drizzling
dir: Brown the Italian sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks. Add the onions, bell pepper, and garlic, cooking until softened, about 5 minutes. Drain excess grease.
Reduce heat to medium-low and add the cream cheese, sour cream, marinara sauce, Parmesan, Italian seasoning, and ranch seasoning. Stir until cream cheese melts and everything is well combined.
Fold in half the pepperoni, the pepperoncini, jalapeños, and red pepper flakes. Transfer mixture to a 9x13 baking dish or large oven-safe skillet.
Top with torn mozzarella and remaining pepperoni. Bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes until bubbly and cheese is melted.
Remove from oven and drizzle Papa John's garlic sauce over the top. Garnish with fresh basil and serve hot with toasted garlic bread for dipping.

d: Pulled Pork BBQ Queso Dip is a creamy, cheesy dip that brings together smoky pulled pork, Velveeta, and pepper jack cheese for an explosion of flavor. The addition of green chilies and sweet corn adds a delightful texture, making it a must-have for any gathering. This dip is perfect for sharing, and once you taste it, you’ll be dreaming of making it again and again!
i: 2 cups BBQ smoked pulled pork, shredded
6 strips bacon, cooked crispy and crumbled
1 (4 oz) can diced green chilies, drained
1/2 cup Devil Spit BBQ sauce (or your favorite spicy BBQ sauce)
dir: In a large skillet or pot over medium heat, melt butter and sauté red onions until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add cream cheese, Velveeta, pepper jack, and Monterey Jack to the pot, stirring frequently until cheeses are fully melted and smooth.
Stir in sour cream, green chilies, corn, baked beans, and black pepper until well combined.
Fold in pulled pork, crumbled bacon, and Devil Spit BBQ sauce, stirring until everything is heated through and evenly mixed, about 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and let simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more BBQ sauce for extra kick or sour cream to mellow it out.
Transfer to a slow cooker on warm setting or serve immediately in a cast iron skillet with tortilla chips, crackers, or fresh vegetables for dipping.

d: Dive into the creamy delight of Jalapeño Poppers Dip, a mouthwatering blend of browned ground beef, diced jalapeños, and sweet corn. Infused with a hint of red onion and topped with melted cheese, each bite delivers a spicy, savory punch that will leave your taste buds dancing. Perfect for gatherings, this dip is a crowd-pleaser that brings the heat!
i: 1 lb bacon, cooked crispy and crumbled
1 lb ground beef or 1 lb chopped smoked chicken thighs
1 cup corn (fresh, frozen, or canned and drained)
1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese, for topping
dir: Preheat oven to 375°F. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the ground beef (or warm the smoked chicken), breaking up the meat as it cooks. Drain excess fat and set aside.
In the same skillet, cook the diced red onion for 2-3 minutes until softened. Add the diced jalapeños and corn, cooking for another 2 minutes.

In a large mixing bowl, combine the cream cheese, sour cream, pepper jack cheese, ranch seasoning, and jalapeño seasoning until well mixed. Fold in the cooked meat, jalapeño-corn mixture, and crumbled bacon.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 baking dish or cast iron skillet and spread evenly. Top with the sharp cheddar cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until hot and bubbly with cheese melted and starting to brown on top. Let cool for 5 minutes before serving with tortilla chips, crackers, or toasted bread.

d: Elevate your dishes with zesty Remoulade Sauce, combining rich mayonnaise, tangy whole grain mustard, and a kick of horseradish. This creamy concoction is perfectly balanced with fresh herbs, Sriracha, and Worcestershire sauce, bringing a burst of flavor to seafood, fries, or sandwiches. Each dip promises a tantalizing taste sensation that will keep you coming back for more!
dir: Finely dice the jalapeños, mince the shallots and garlic, and chop all the fresh herbs.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, sour cream, whole grain mustard, and horseradish until smooth.
Add the Siracha, hot sauce, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, pickle relish, and all the spices. Stir until well combined.
Fold in the jalapeños, shallots, garlic, and fresh herbs. Mix thoroughly.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to let the flavors come together. Taste and adjust seasoning with more hot sauce or Creole seasoning if needed.

d: Asian Peanut Sauce is a luxurious blend of creamy peanut butter, sticky honey, and savory soy sauce that creates a rich, irresistible dip or dressing. Enhanced with the bright notes of lime juice, sesame oil, and a kick from sriracha and garlic chili paste, it's the perfect accompaniment for spring rolls, salads, or grilled chicken. This sauce is a flavor explosion that will transport your palate straight to the streets of Asia!
dir: In a medium bowl, whisk together peanut butter, honey, and brown sugar until smooth.
Add soy sauce, rice vinegar, lime juice, sesame oil, sriracha, garlic chili paste, and chili crisp. Whisk until well combined.
Stir in minced ginger, garlic, and red chili flakes. Mix thoroughly.
Add warm water a tablespoon at a time, whisking until sauce reaches your desired consistency (thicker for dipping, thinner for drizzling).
Taste and adjust heat level with more sriracha or chili crisp if desired. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 weeks.

d: Polynesian Sauce is a tropical treat featuring a vibrant mix of Catalina dressing, honey, and pineapple juice that’s both sweet and tangy. Enhanced with apple cider vinegar, smoked paprika, and a hint of brown sugar, this sauce brings a delightful balance that enhances grilled meats and salads alike. It's a taste of the islands in every bite, making your meals feel like a mini-vacation!
dir: In a medium bowl, whisk together the Catalina dressing, honey (start with 2 tablespoons), and pineapple juice until smooth.
Add the apple cider vinegar (start with 1 tablespoon), smoked paprika, dried mustard, and brown sugar. Whisk until well combined.
Taste and adjust: add more honey if you want it sweeter, or more vinegar if you want extra tang.
Use immediately or transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks. Stir well before using.

d: Better Chick-fil-A Sauce is a game-changer that melds rich mayonnaise, zesty BBQ sauce, and honey mustard into a creamy, irresistible blend. Infused with sautéed onions, jalapeños, and a touch of hot honey, this sauce packs a punch that will elevate your chicken nuggets and fries to new heights. One dip will have you hooked, transforming your meals into a flavorful experience!
dir: In a skillet over medium heat, melt butter and sauté the onion, bell pepper, jalapeño, and garlic until soft and fragrant, about 5-6 minutes. Let cool completely.
In a medium bowl, combine mayonnaise, BBQ sauce, honey mustard, tomato paste, and hot honey. Whisk until smooth.
Stir in the pickles, pickle juice, cherry peppers, and cooled sautéed vegetables.
Add black pepper and chili powder, then mix well. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving to let the flavors blend together.

d: The Bussin Breakfast Burrito is a hearty breakfast wrap loaded with crispy pork belly, smoky green chiles, and sweet corn. This incredible combination is drizzled with zesty hot honey, creating a flavor explosion that will make your mornings feel special. Dive into this delightful burrito for a satisfying start to your day!
i: 2 cups roasted potatoes or crispy fries
2 tablespoons chipotle peppers in adobo, minced
dir: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, sauté the onions, bell pepper, garlic, green chiles, and corn until softened, about 6-8 minutes. Set aside and keep warm.
In the same skillet, cook the pork belly cubes until crispy, about 8-10 minutes. Drizzle with hot honey, toss to coat, and set aside.

In a bowl, whisk together 6 eggs, mayonnaise, melted butter, and jalapeño powder. Pour onto a microwave-safe plate and microwave for 50 seconds until just set. Meanwhile, make the sauce by mixing Cholula, chipotle adobo, cilantro, and sour cream in a small bowl.
In a small skillet, gently cook 3 egg yolks over low heat until the edges are set but the centers are still runny, about 2-3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas and layer each with the microwaved scrambled eggs, sautéed vegetables, hot honey pork belly, roasted potatoes or fries, and all four cheeses.
Drizzle generously with the chipotle-cilantro cream sauce, top with a runny egg yolk, and add salsa and guacamole if desired.
Wrap that shit up tight, tucking in the sides as you roll. Serve immediately while everything's hot and the yolk is still runny.

d: Elevate your burger game with Cajun Honey Burger Sauce, a luscious blend of sautéed onions, garlic, and vibrant red and green peppers. The addition of Worcestershire sauce gives it a savory depth, perfectly balancing the sweet and spicy elements. This sauce will make every bite of your burger sing with flavor, leaving you craving more!
dir: In a medium skillet over medium heat, melt butter and add diced onions, garlic, red pepper, and green pepper.
Sauté vegetables for 6-8 minutes until softened and lightly caramelized, then add Worcestershire sauce and cook for 1 more minute.
Remove skillet from heat and let the vegetables cool for 5 minutes.
In a medium bowl, combine mayonnaise, tomato paste, yellow mustard, Cajun seasoning, honey, and black pepper.
Add the cooled sautéed vegetables to the mayo mixture and stir until well combined.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more Cajun seasoning or honey if desired, then refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving to let flavors meld.

d: Cajun Alfredo Wing Sauce is a creamy, luxurious dip that transforms your wings into a decadent feast. Infused with roasted garlic, buttery sautéed onions, and rich heavy cream, this sauce packs a savory punch that is simply irresistible. It's the ultimate indulgence for wing lovers, making your game day even more exciting!
dir: Roast the garlic: Cut top off garlic head, drizzle with oil, wrap in foil, and roast at 400°F for 35-40 minutes until soft. Squeeze out cloves and mash into a paste.
In a medium saucepan over medium heat, melt butter. Add sautéed onions and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add heavy cream, cream cheese, and roasted garlic paste. Whisk until cream cheese is melted and smooth, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, Cajun seasoning, Italian seasoning, chicken bouillon, and black pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add grated Parmesan and whisk until melted and sauce is creamy. Stir in crumbled bacon and lemon juice.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. If sauce is too thick, thin with a splash of cream or chicken broth.
Toss with your cooked wings and top with shaved Parmesan before serving.

t: Pineapple Jalapeno cream cheese bacon jam
d: Pineapple Jalapeno Cream Cheese Bacon Jam is a sweet and spicy spread that marries crispy bacon with caramelized onions and vibrant jalapeños. The addition of juicy pineapple creates a delicious contrast, making it an addictive topping for crackers or toast. This jam is a true party starter that will have everyone coming back for more!
dir: Cook chopped bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 8-10 minutes. Remove bacon and set aside, leaving 2 tablespoons of drippings in the pan.
Add diced onion to the bacon drippings and cook until caramelized, about 8 minutes. Stir in jalapeños and pineapple, cooking for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Return bacon to the skillet and add brown sugar, vinegar, and chipotle powder. Simmer on low heat for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mixture thickens into a jam consistency.
Remove from heat and let cool completely to room temperature, about 30 minutes.
Once cooled, fold in softened cream cheese until well combined and creamy. Serve with crackers, toast points, or as a burger topping.

d: Asian Cucumber Salad is a refreshing dish that combines crisp cucumbers, crunchy cabbage, and zesty red onions. Tossed in a tangy dressing made with rice vinegar, soy sauce, and a hint of sweet chili sauce, each bite is a burst of flavor. Perfect as a side or a light meal, this salad will add vibrancy to your table!
dir: Slice cucumbers as thin as possible using a mandoline or sharp knife. Combine with shredded cabbage and sliced red onion in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, sweet chili sauce, crispy chili oil, sugar, garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes until sugar dissolves completely.
Pour dressing over cucumbers and cabbage, tossing well to coat everything evenly.
Refrigerate for at least 10–15 minutes to let the flavors meld together.
Before serving, top with sesame seeds, sliced green onions, and crushed peanuts if using.

d: This Thai chili bacon jam is a savory-sweet condiment that elevates any dish. Featuring crispy bacon, fragrant shallots, fiery Thai chilis, and rich garlic, it delivers an explosion of flavors. The smoky, spicy undertones paired with the sweetness create an addictive topping perfect for burgers, toast, or charcuterie boards!
dir: Cook the diced bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 8-10 minutes. Remove bacon and set aside, leaving 2 tablespoons of bacon fat in the pan.
Add shallots, garlic, and Thai chilis to the bacon fat and cook until softened and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes.
Return the bacon to the pan and add sweet Thai chili sauce, soy sauce, chicken stock, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
Simmer over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until the mixture thickens and reduces to a jam-like consistency, about 25-30 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in lime juice and fresh basil. Let cool slightly before serving or storing in the refrigerator.

d: Pepperoni cherry tomato jam is a unique blend of savory and sweet, combining crispy pepperoni and juicy cherry tomatoes. Enhanced by sautéed onions, garlic, and fragrant Italian seasoning, this jam is bursting with flavor. Spread it on crostini or use it as a pizza topping for an unforgettable twist on classic Italian tastes!
dir: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the diced pepperoni until it starts to crisp and releases its oils, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and sauté until softened and fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the cherry tomatoes, sun-dried tomatoes, sugar, and Italian seasoning. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes break down and the mixture thickens to a jam-like consistency, about 25-30 minutes.
If the jam gets too thick, add a tablespoon of water at a time. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Let cool slightly before transferring to jars. Serve warm or at room temperature with crackers or bread.

d: This honey garlic sauce is a luscious blend that transforms any dish into a delicious masterpiece. With a base of sweet honey, umami-rich soy sauce, and a hint of zesty rice vinegar, it's the perfect balance of sweet and savory. Drizzle it over meats, toss it with veggies, or use it as a dip—once you try it, you'll be hooked!
dir: In a small bowl, whisk together the cornstarch and water to make a slurry; set aside.
In a medium saucepan over medium heat, add the sesame oil and sauté the minced garlic and shallots until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add the honey, ketchup, soy sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, and red pepper flakes to the pan. Stir well and bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook for 2-3 minutes until the sauce thickens to your liking.
Remove from heat and stir in the sesame seeds. Let cool slightly before using — the sauce will thicken more as it cools.

d: Sesame chicken is a delightful dish that features tender chicken pieces coated in a rich, sticky sauce made of soy sauce, honey, and garlic. The addition of Sriracha brings a subtle heat that perfectly complements the sweetness. It's an irresistible meal that’s quick to make and exploding with flavor—perfect for a weeknight dinner or impressing guests!
i: 1½ lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
dir: In a medium bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, ketchup, rice vinegar, raw sugar, garlic, red chili flakes, and Sriracha until well combined.
Heat 2 tablespoons sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken pieces and cook 5-7 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Pour sauce over chicken and bring to a simmer. Mix cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water to make a slurry, then stir into the pan.
Let simmer 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens and coats the chicken nicely. Drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon sesame oil.
Remove from heat, sprinkle with sesame seeds and sliced green onions, and serve over rice.

t: Crispy Honey Lemon Pepper Wing Sauce
d: Crispy honey lemon pepper wing sauce is a tantalizing blend that brings your wings to a new level of flavor. With a kick from cayenne and a zesty brightness from lemon juice and zest, it's perfectly balanced by the sweetness of hot honey. This sauce delivers a delightful crunch and zing that will have everyone reaching for seconds!
dir: In a small bowl, mix cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water to make a slurry and set aside.
Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add hot honey, sriracha, lemon juice, lemon zest, lemon pepper, black pepper, cayenne, and chili crisp oil. Stir well and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook for 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Remove from heat and stir in green onions. If using, whisk in sour cream until smooth.
Toss immediately with hot crispy wings, making sure every piece gets coated in that sticky, spicy goodness.

d: Cowboy Ranch is a creamy, herbaceous dipping sauce perfect for drizzling over salads or serving with veggies. It features a rich blend of mayonnaise, sour cream, and buttermilk, enhanced with zesty lemon juice and aromatic herbs like parsley and dill. This tangy and flavorful ranch will elevate any dish, making it a must-have for those who crave a burst of freshness!
dir: In a medium bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, sour cream, and buttermilk until smooth and well combined.
Add the minced garlic, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, lemon zest, and ranch seasoning. Whisk until fully incorporated.
Stir in the parsley, dill, chives, thyme, paprika, cayenne, and red pepper flakes. If using cottage cheese, blend it in until mostly smooth.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to let the flavors meld together. Taste and adjust seasoning with more cayenne or salt if needed before serving.

d: Orange Chicken sauce is a vibrant and sticky glaze that transforms ordinary chicken into a savory-sweet sensation. Made with fresh orange juice, soy sauce, and a hint of sesame oil, this sauce is balanced with garlic and ginger pastes, a touch of brown sugar, and zesty orange marmalade. The result is an irresistible, tangy flavor that brings a taste of takeout to your kitchen, perfect for any weeknight dinner!
dir: In a medium saucepan, whisk together orange juice, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic paste, ginger paste, brown sugar, rice wine vinegar, orange zest, and marmalade until well combined.
In a small bowl, mix cornstarch with 3 tablespoons cold water to make a slurry and set aside.
Bring the sauce mixture to a simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally, then add the red chili flakes.
Once simmering, slowly whisk in the cornstarch slurry and cook for 2-3 minutes until the sauce thickens to a glossy consistency.
Remove from heat and stir in sesame seeds. Taste and adjust sweetness or heat as needed.
Toss with crispy fried chicken pieces or serve over rice with your protein of choice.

d: Garlic Parmesan Sauce is a luscious, creamy dressing that’s all about indulgent flavor and rich texture. Combining melted butter, fragrant minced garlic, and heavy cream creates a dreamy base, while tangy Parmesan cheese adds a delightful umami kick. This sauce is a game changer for pasta, pizza, or even as a dip, ensuring every bite is a heavenly experience!
dir: Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, stirring constantly to avoid burning.
Whisk together heavy cream and cornstarch in a small bowl until smooth. Pour into the saucepan with the garlic butter.
Add mayonnaise (or sour cream), Parmesan cheese, lemon juice, white vinegar, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper. Whisk until well combined.
Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring frequently, and cook for 3-4 minutes until sauce thickens to your desired consistency.
Remove from heat and stir in fresh chives and parsley. Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt, pepper, or lemon juice if needed.
Serve warm as a dipping sauce or let cool slightly for a thicker consistency. Store leftovers in the fridge for up to 5 days.

d: Blue Cheese Crazy Chunky Sauce is a decadent, chunky spread that’s bursting with bold flavors. This unique blend brings together creamy blue cheese, cottage cheese, and mayo, enriched with minced garlic, dill, and crunchy bits of dehydrated cucumber and red bell pepper. Perfect for slathering on burgers or as a dip for veggies, this sauce is a flavor explosion that's sure to impress!
i: 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped (or 1 tablespoon dried)
1/4 cup dehydrated red bell pepper pieces
dir: In a large mixing bowl, combine the blue cheese, cottage cheese, mayonnaise, and sour cream until well blended but still chunky.
Add the minced garlic, dill, salt, and coarse black pepper, stirring to incorporate.
Stir in the dehydrated cucumber, red onion, and red bell pepper pieces.
Add the lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, olive oil, and red wine vinegar, mixing until everything is evenly distributed.
Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more pepper or salt as needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to let the flavors meld and the dehydrated veggies soften slightly before serving.

d: BBQ Buffalo Wing Sauce is a fiery, finger-licking blend that takes your wings to the next level. Loaded with tangy Buffalo sauce, sweet honey, and smoky BBQ sauce, it’s elevated with fresh lime juice and a kick of red pepper flakes. This tantalizing sauce is perfect for game day or any gathering, making every bite a deliciously spicy celebration!
dir: Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, stirring frequently to avoid burning.
Stir in Buffalo sauce, BBQ sauce, honey, lime juice, BBQ dry rub, and red pepper flakes.
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning — add more honey for sweetness, more Buffalo sauce for heat, or more lime juice for tang.
Remove from heat and toss with cooked wings, or store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

d: This Mango Habanero Sauce is a vibrant blend of sweet and spicy, featuring luscious mango puree, fiery minced habaneros, and fragrant garlic. Finished with a squeeze of zesty lime juice and a touch of honey, each dip explodes with flavor. Perfect for adding a kick to grilled meats or as a bold dressing for fresh salads!
dir: In a medium saucepan, combine the mango puree, minced habaneros, honey, and garlic over medium heat.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened.
Stir in the lime juice, green onions, paprika, and salt. Simmer for another 3-4 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Taste and adjust seasoning with more honey for sweetness or lime juice for tang.
Use immediately or store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

d: Dave's Hot Chicken Sauce is a creamy and spicy delight made with rich mayonnaise, smoky chipotle sauce, and a dash of brown sugar for balance. This sauce is exceptionally versatile, enhancing everything from crispy chicken to fries. Its tangy notes from apple cider vinegar and the warmth from sautéed onions will have your taste buds dancing!
dir: In a medium bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, chipotle sauce, brown sugar, and honey until smooth.
Finely chop the sautéed onions and add them to the mayo mixture along with the garlic salt and black pepper.
Stir in the apple cider vinegar and mix until everything is well combined.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed — add more chipotle for heat, honey for sweetness, or vinegar for tang.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors marry before serving with your fried chicken.

d: Creamy Avocado Lime Sauce is a luxurious, zesty dip featuring roasted jalapeños and garlic, blended to perfection. The smokiness from the charred veggies combined with fresh lime creates a refreshingly bold flavor. Drizzle it over tacos, grilled fish, or salads, and watch it elevate any dish to a tropical paradise!
dir: Roast the jalapeños and unpeeled garlic cloves in a dry skillet over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until charred and softened (about 8-10 minutes for jalapeños, 12-15 for garlic).
Remove stems and seeds from jalapeños if you want less heat, then roughly chop. Peel the roasted garlic cloves.
Add avocados, cilantro, lime juice, sour cream, mayo, roasted jalapeños, and roasted garlic to a blender or food processor.
Blend until smooth and creamy, scraping down sides as needed. Add a tablespoon or two of water if you want a thinner consistency.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and add more lime juice if desired. Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 2 days.

d: Pineapple Chipotle Mayo Sauce is a tropical twist on classic mayo, with finely chopped chipotle peppers and sweet pineapple chunks. The adobo sauce complements the honey and cilantro, adding layers of flavor that are smoky, sweet, and tangy. This sauce is an irresistible companion for sandwiches and grilled shrimp that will take your taste buds on a flavorful journey!
i: 3 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, finely chopped
2 tablespoons adobo sauce from the can
1 cup pineapple chunks (canned or fresh), finely diced
dir: Finely chop the chipotle peppers and pineapple chunks, making sure they're small enough to blend smoothly into the sauce.
In a medium bowl, combine the mayonnaise, chopped chipotles, adobo sauce, diced pineapple, and pineapple juice.
Add the honey, cilantro, black pepper, and garlic powder, stirring until everything is well mixed.
Taste and adjust seasoning — add more honey for sweetness, more chipotles for heat, or a pinch of salt if needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors come together before serving.

d: Big Mac Sauce is the secret ingredient that makes burgers sing! Combining creamy mayo, tangy relish, and sweet caramelized onions, this sauce is a nostalgic nod to the classic. A hint of paprika adds warmth, making it a must-have for your next burger night, ensuring every bite is bursting with savory goodness!
i: 2 cloves roasted garlic, mashed into paste
dir: Roast 2 cloves of garlic in a 400°F oven wrapped in foil for 25-30 minutes until soft and caramelized, then mash into a paste and let cool.
Finely chop the caramelized onions if not already finely chopped.
In a medium bowl, combine the mayo, yellow mustard, caramelized onions, sweet relish, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, and roasted garlic paste.
Add the pickle juice and white vinegar, then whisk everything together until smooth and well combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld together.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed — add more pickle juice for tang or a pinch of sugar if you want it sweeter.

d: This Dr Pepper BBQ Wing Sauce is a sweet and tangy glaze that elevates your wings to new heights! Key players include Dr Pepper, Worcestershire sauce, and chili powder, creating a rich depth of flavor. The combination of sweetness from the brown sugar and a kick from the cayenne makes every bite irresistible, perfect for your next game day or backyard BBQ.
dir: Combine Dr Pepper, ketchup, brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, and yellow mustard in a medium saucepan.
Whisk in chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and cayenne until well combined.
Bring sauce to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and reduces by about half.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Toss with cooked wings or use as a glaze during the last few minutes of cooking.

d: Dive into the bold flavors of Sunkist Buffalo Wing Sauce, a zesty twist on the classic! This sauce features Frank's RedHot, Sunkist orange soda, and fresh orange zest, giving it a citrusy kick alongside the heat. The delightful balance of sweetness and spiciness makes it a must-try for wing lovers looking to jazz up their appetizer game!
dir: Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in Frank's RedHot, Sunkist orange soda, brown sugar, orange zest, and red pepper flakes. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly and reduces by about one-third.
Remove from heat and stir in hot honey. Taste and adjust sweetness or heat as needed.
Toss with cooked wings immediately or let cool and store in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

d: Coca Cola BBQ Glaze is a sticky-sweet sauce that enhances any grilled dish with its unique flavor profile. Combining Coca-Cola, BBQ sauce, and smoked paprika results in a robust, caramelized glaze that's absolutely mouthwatering. Perfect for slathering on ribs or burgers, this glaze will have your taste buds dancing with delight!
dir: Combine the Coca-Cola, BBQ sauce, ketchup, brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, and Worcestershire sauce in a medium saucepan.
Stir in the smoked paprika and garlic powder until well combined.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low.
Simmer uncovered for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the glaze is reduced by half and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly — the glaze will continue to thicken as it cools.
Brush generously on burgers, ribs, or chicken during the last minute of cooking for a glossy, caramelized finish.

d: Transform your burgers with this Peach Chutney BBQ Burger Topping, bursting with fruity and savory goodness! Fresh peaches, minced ginger, and diced onions simmer together for a sweet and tangy complement that takes your grilling game to the next level. This vibrant chutney adds depth and a refreshing twist, making every bite a celebration of summer flavors!
dir: Peel and dice peaches into 1/2-inch pieces. Finely dice onion and mince ginger.
Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan and stir to mix well.
Bring mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce to a simmer.
Cook uncovered for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mixture thickens to a jam-like consistency.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly. The chutney will continue to thicken as it cools.
Spoon generously over grilled burgers topped with sharp white cheddar or Brie. Store leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

d: Ripe peaches are a versatile delight that can elevate any dish with their juicy sweetness! When diced and simmered, they transform into a jam-like consistency that captures the essence of summer. Perfect for topping pancakes, adding to smoothies, or simply enjoying by the spoonful, these peaches will make your taste buds sing with joy!
dir: Peel and dice the peaches into 1/2-inch cubes, discarding the pits.
Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium-low and cook uncovered for 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until mixture thickens to a jam-like consistency.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature. The chutney will thicken further as it cools.
Serve alongside sharp white cheddar or Brie on burgers, or spread on crackers as an appetizer. Store refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

d: This Tomato Jam burger topping is a sweet and savory spread that elevates any burger. Featuring ripe Roma tomatoes, a medley of spices, and a touch of sugar, this jam transforms simple ingredients into a flavor-packed delight. Its thick, rich consistency and tangy sweetness will have you slathering it on everything, ensuring each bite is a burst of deliciousness.
dir: Chop the Roma tomatoes into rough chunks and set aside.
Combine all ingredients in a heavy-bottomed pot and stir well to mix.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 45-60 minutes, stirring often to prevent sticking, until the mixture is thick and jammy.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt or cayenne if needed.
Let cool completely before transferring to jars. Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

d: Dive into the mouthwatering Crazy Chicken Sandwiches, where crispy fried chicken thighs steal the show! Drenched in a flavorful buttermilk and hot sauce mixture, then coated in a seasoned blend of flour and potato starch, each bite offers a delightful crunch and tender juiciness. Personalize your spice level with curry powder for a Tikka Masala twist or an extra kick of cayenne for Buffalo heat—these sandwiches are sure to satisfy your cravings!
i: 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper (adjust per sandwich style)
4-6 cups lard or beef tallow (for frying)
8 yellow potato buns or brioche buns
Your choice of sauce/topping combo from the Master List (see notes)
Suggested toppings per sandwich style: pickles, coleslaw, lettuce, tomatoes, onions, cheese, etc.
dir: Set up your breading station: In one bowl, mix buttermilk, eggs, and hot sauce. In another bowl, combine flour, potato starch, chicken bouillon, and spices (adjust spices based on your chosen Chicksan style — add curry powder for Tikka Masala, extra cayenne for Buffalo, etc.).

Pound chicken thighs to even thickness if needed. Dip each thigh in buttermilk mixture, then dredge in seasoned flour mixture, pressing to coat well. For extra crispy coating, double-dip: back in buttermilk, then flour again.

Heat lard or tallow in a large cast iron skillet or Dutch oven to 350°F. Fry chicken thighs in batches for 6-8 minutes per side until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165°F. Don't crowd the pan. Drain on a wire rack.
While chicken rests, butter the cut sides of your buns and toast them in a skillet or under the broiler until golden brown.

Prepare your chosen sauce and toppings from the Master List. For example: Butter Chicken Chicksan gets butter chicken sauce, pickled red onions, tomatoes, goat cheese, and mint cucumber lassi drizzle.
Assemble sandwiches: Bottom bun, fried chicken thigh, your signature sauce, creative toppings that match the flavor profile, top bun. Serve immediately while chicken is hot and crispy.

d: Brown Sugar Hot Wing Sauce is a fiery-sweet glaze that takes your wings to the next level. The combination of Frank's RedHot sauce and rich brown sugar creates an irresistible sticky coating that caramelizes beautifully. Finished with a splash of hot honey for an extra layer of flavor, this sauce promises a sweet heat that will keep you coming back for more!
dir: In a small saucepan, combine Frank's RedHot sauce and brown sugar over medium heat.
Stir constantly until brown sugar is completely dissolved, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in hot honey until well combined.
Let cool for 5 minutes before tossing with cooked wings.
Taste and adjust sweetness or heat as needed — add more brown sugar for sweeter, more hot sauce for spicier.

d: Experience the umami explosion of Sweet Gochujang Aioli, a creamy condiment that packs a punch! Combining luscious mayonnaise with the spicy-sweet gochujang paste, fragrant sesame oil, and a hint of rice vinegar, this sauce is a flavor bomb for any dish. Toss in minced garlic and sautéed onions for extra depth, and you'll find yourself drenching everything in this addictive aioli!
dir: In a medium bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, gochujang paste, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and honey until smooth and well combined.
Stir in the minced garlic and finely chopped sautéed onions until evenly distributed throughout the aioli.
Add the sesame seeds and mix well.
Taste and adjust seasoning — add more honey for sweetness, gochujang for heat, or rice vinegar for tang as needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld together before serving.

t: Candied Bacon, Jalapeños, and Apples Burger Topping
d: Transform your burger with a heavenly blend of Candied Bacon, Jalapeños, and Apples! Crispy bacon, brushed with maple syrup and raw sugar, becomes a sweet and salty topping that perfectly complements the heat from jalapeños and the crispness of fresh apples. This topping is not just flavorful; it's an exciting textural journey that will elevate your burger game to legendary status!
i: 2 medium red apples, cored and diced
dir: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange bacon slices in a single layer. Brush bacon with maple syrup and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons raw sugar. Bake for 20-25 minutes until crispy and caramelized. Let cool, then chop into bite-sized pieces.
While bacon bakes, combine 1/2 cup raw sugar, apple cider vinegar, and red pepper flakes in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring to dissolve sugar.
Add sliced jalapeños to the boiling mixture and reduce heat to medium-low. Simmer for 5 minutes until jalapeños are slightly softened.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature. Dice the red apples into small chunks.
In a bowl, combine the candied bacon pieces, pickled jalapeños (with some of their liquid), and diced apples. Toss gently to mix.
Store in a jar or airtight container in the refrigerator. Spoon generously over burgers just before serving.

d: This Smash Burger Copy Cat Sauce is the ultimate topping for any burger lover! Featuring creamy mayonnaise, zesty Sriracha, and tangy Worcestershire sauce, it packs a flavor punch that's irresistible. The sautéed shallots add a sweet depth, making every bite incredibly savory and utterly satisfying.
i: Salt and black pepper to taste
dir: In a small skillet, sauté the minced shallots in a little butter or oil over medium heat until soft and translucent, about 3-4 minutes. Let cool completely.
In a medium bowl, combine the mayonnaise, ketchup, horseradish, Worcestershire sauce, and Sriracha.
Add the cooled sautéed shallots and garlic powder to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, starting with 1/4 teaspoon of each and adjusting as needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving to let the flavors meld together. Sauce will keep in the fridge for up to a week.

d: Elevate your burger experience with this Classic Burger Sauce, a creamy blend of mayonnaise, ketchup, and yellow mustard. The diced dill pickles and crispy bacon bits bring a delightful crunch, while the Worcestershire sauce and garlic powder infuse savory notes that are simply mouthwatering. Perfect for slathering on burgers or dipping fries, it’s a condiment you can't live without!
dir: In a mixing bowl, combine the mayonnaise, ketchup, and yellow mustard.
Stir in the pickle juice, diced dill pickles, and sautéed onions until well mixed.
Add the crispy bacon bits, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Mix everything together until fully combined and creamy.
Taste the sauce and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more salt or pepper to your liking.
Refrigerate for at least 10 minutes to let the flavors meld before serving.

d: Transform your dishes with the Hot Honey Apple Mayo Sauce, a sweet and spicy blend that brings the perfect balance of flavors. Made with mayonnaise and a kick of Sriracha, it’s complemented by tangy sautéed onions and crisp red apple for a refreshing bite. This sauce is a game-changer that adds excitement to sandwiches, salads, or as a dip!
dir: In a medium bowl, combine the mayonnaise, Sriracha, and hot honey, stirring until smooth.
Add the sautéed onions and diced red apple to the bowl, mixing well to combine.
If using, fold in the minced roasted garlic for extra flavor.
Taste the sauce and adjust the seasoning if needed, adding more Sriracha or hot honey to your liking.
Serve immediately as a dip or spread, or refrigerate for up to an hour to let the flavors meld.

d: This White Whole Grain Burger Sauce offers a unique twist with its hearty blend of whole grain mustard and sweet sautéed onions. The creamy mayonnaise, tangy dill pickles, and a touch of paprika provide a flavorful depth that elevates any burger. It’s the perfect combo of textures and tastes that makes your backyard BBQ unforgettable!
dir: In a small skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the sautéed sweet yellow onions and cook until they are golden and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes.
In a mixing bowl, combine the mayonnaise, whole grain mustard, chopped dill pickles, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the sautéed onions to the mixing bowl and stir until all ingredients are well combined.
Taste the sauce and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more black pepper or Worcestershire sauce to your liking.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld together.

d: Indulge in the fusion of flavors with this Butter Chicken Sandwich, featuring crispy chicken strips coated in a spiced flour mixture with curry powder that ignites your palate. Pan-fried to golden perfection, the tender chicken is a mouthwatering twist on a classic favorite. This sandwich promises a tantalizing taste experience that will have you craving more!
i: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into strips
dir: In a large bowl, mix together the all-purpose flour, corn starch, curry powder, salt, and pepper.
Coat each chicken strip in the seasoned flour mixture, ensuring they are well covered.
Heat the lard in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once hot, fry the chicken strips until golden brown and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and drain on paper towels.
In the same skillet, add the butter chicken sauce and simmer for a couple of minutes until warmed through.
Place the fried chicken strips on the potato buns, top with red onion slices, tomato slices, and crumbled goat cheese.
Drizzle the Mint Cucumber Lassi over the top, then close the sandwiches and serve.

d: Cool Cole Slaw is a refreshing medley of vibrant red and green cabbage, crunchy carrots, and sweet onions, all tossed in a creamy dressing made with mayonnaise and tangy apple cider vinegar. The addition of celery seed adds a subtle crunch and earthiness that complements the crisp vegetables beautifully. This slaw is not just a side; it’s a crunchy, vibrant delight that perfectly complements any meal!
dir: In a large bowl, combine the red cabbage, green cabbage, grated carrots, and chopped onions.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, apple cider vinegar, celery seed, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the cabbage mixture and toss until everything is well coated.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld.
Before serving, give the slaw a good stir and adjust seasoning with more salt and pepper if needed.

t: Bacon Onion and Roasted Garlic Jam
d: Transform your dishes with this Bacon Onion and Roasted Garlic Jam, a sweet and savory spread that combines crispy bacon with slowly caramelized onions and rich garlic. The layers of flavor create a symphony on your palate, making it the perfect accompaniment for cheese boards or sandwiches. Once you taste it, you'll be hooked on its irresistible richness!
dir: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the diced bacon until crispy, about 8-10 minutes. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon and set aside, leaving the bacon fat in the skillet.
Add the diced onions to the skillet and reduce the heat to low. Cook the onions slowly, stirring occasionally, until they are deeply caramelized, about 30-40 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, and bourbon maple syrup to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Return the crispy bacon to the skillet and let the mixture simmer on low for about 15-20 minutes, or until it thickens to a jammy consistency.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Let the jam cool slightly before transferring to a jar. It will thicken more as it rests.

d: Creamed Spinach is the ultimate indulgent side dish, featuring fresh spinach sautéed with fragrant garlic and enveloped in a silky cream cheese and heavy cream sauce. The combination of flavors makes each bite a comforting delight, perfect for elevating any meal. This creamy, luscious dish is sure to become a favorite at your dinner table!
i: 1 pound fresh spinach, washed and chopped
dir: In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the cream cheese and heavy cream, mixing until the cream cheese is completely melted and incorporated.
Add the grated Parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes, stirring until everything is well combined and heated through.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Serve warm as a delicious side dish.

d: These Creamy Greek Lemon Herb Potatoes are a delightful side dish featuring Yukon Gold potatoes, infused with zesty fresh lemon juice, aromatic olive oil, and fragrant herbs. The combination of chicken broth and rich olive oil creates a velvety texture that's simply irresistible. Elevate your meals with this creamy, tangy, and herbaceous dish that will have everyone asking for seconds!
i: 2 lbs Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
1/4 cup sour cream or Greek yogurt
dir: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) if roasting the potatoes.
In a large pot, combine the Yukon Gold potatoes, chicken broth, and enough water to cover them. Bring to a boil and cook until fork-tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain and set aside.

In a mixing bowl, whisk together the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, sour cream or Greek yogurt, minced garlic, diced red onion, rosemary, thyme, Italian seasoning, chicken bouillon, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
If roasting, spread the cooked potatoes on a baking sheet, pour the herb mixture over them, and toss to coat. Roast in the oven for about 15 minutes until golden and crispy.
If boiling, return the potatoes to the pot, add the herb mixture, and gently stir to coat the potatoes in the creamy sauce.
Adjust seasoning to taste, adding more salt, pepper, or lemon juice if desired.
Serve warm, and if you’ve roasted chicken thighs, feel free to mix in some of the chicken drippings for extra flavor. Enjoy!

d: This Mediterranean White Sauce is a luscious blend of Greek yogurt, creamy mayonnaise, and zesty lemon juice, combined with refreshing rehydrated cucumber and roasted garlic. Infused with fragrant parsley and za'atar seasoning, it delivers a burst of flavor that’s perfect for drizzling or dipping. This sauce is a must-have accompaniment that will elevate your culinary creations to a whole new level!
i: 1/4 cup skinless cucumber, dehydrated and rehydrated
dir: In a bowl, combine the Greek yogurt, mayonnaise or sour cream, olive oil, and lemon juice until smooth.
Add the rehydrated cucumber, roasted garlic, white onion, parsley, za'atar seasoning, and black pepper to the bowl.
If using, stir in the fresh mint.
Mix all ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, adding more salt or lemon juice if desired.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld before serving.

d: Dive into the vibrant flavors of this Mexican Creamy Bean Sauce, where creamy refried beans meet tangy lime juice, rich sour cream, and spicy Cholula hot sauce. The addition of crumbled Cotija cheese and pickled jalapeños adds layers of texture and zestiness that will tantalize your taste buds. Perfect for tacos or as a dip, this sauce is a fiesta of flavors that will spice up any meal!
i: 1 can (15 oz) full fat refried beans
1 cup Cjota cheese or goat cheese, crumbled
2 tablespoons Cholula hot sauce (or to taste)
dir: In a large mixing bowl, combine the refried beans, sour cream, and mayonnaise until smooth.
Stir in the crumbled Cjota cheese (or goat cheese), diced green chilies, chopped pickled jalapeños, Cholula hot sauce, lime juice, taco seasoning, and black pepper.
If using, add the oregano and Taco Bell sauce to the mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a saucepan over medium heat and cook for about 10-15 minutes, stirring regularly until heated through.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, adding more hot sauce or lime juice if you like it spicier or tangier.
Serve warm over tacos, nachos, or as a dip with tortilla chips.

t: Fresh and Crisp Garden Chicken Wrap
d: The Fresh and Crisp Garden Chicken Wrap combines tender shredded rotisserie chicken with a medley of diced apples, tangy pickled red onions, and crunchy tortilla chips. Dressed in a creamy mixture of sour cream and In-N-Out sauce, this wrap is a delightful balance of savory and sweet. Enjoy a satisfying, fresh bite that’s perfect for lunch or a light dinner, and experience the joyous crunch in every mouthful!
i: 1/4 cup In-N-Out sauce or Ken's Thousand Island dressing
4 tomato basil wraps or large flour tortillas
dir: In a large bowl, combine the shredded rotisserie chicken, diced red and green apples, sliced white onion, pickled red onions, crushed tortilla chips, and garlic herb seasoning.
In a separate small bowl, mix together the sour cream, mayonnaise, and In-N-Out sauce or Thousand Island dressing until well combined.
Pour the dressing mixture over the chicken and apple mixture, and toss everything together until evenly coated.
If using, stir in the cooked white rice for added heartiness.
Lay out your tomato basil wraps or flour tortillas on a flat surface.
Divide the chicken mixture evenly among the wraps, then roll them up tightly.
Slice the wraps in half and serve cold, or chill in the fridge until ready to eat.

d: Savor the delightful combination of juicy chicken thighs and fragrant basmati rice in this Lemon Rosemary Chicken Rice dish. Infused with fresh lemon juice and seasoned with aromatic rosemary, every bite bursts with flavor, complemented by the richness of chicken stock. It’s a comforting, one-pan meal that promises to impress at your dinner table, making weeknight cooking a breeze!
dir: Step 1: In a large skillet, sear the chicken thighs over medium-high heat until cooked through, about 6-8 minutes per side. Remove the chicken and save the grease in the pan.

Step 2: In the same pan, add the basmati rice, 1/4 cup lemon juice, and enough chicken stock (about 3 cups total) to cover the rice. Bring to a simmer, then cover and cook for about 15-20 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Step 3: While the rice cooks, shred or chop the cooked chicken thighs, keeping the skin on.

Step 4: Pour the remaining chicken stock into the skillet used for the chicken. Add the diced onion, minced garlic, and diced red pepper. Sauté for about 5 minutes until the vegetables are soft and the brown bits are deglazed.
Step 5: Fold the cooked rice and chopped chicken into the skillet with the sautéed veggies and broth, mixing well.
Step 6: Season the mixture with lemon pepper, extra lemon juice, plenty of rosemary, parsley, and mint. Stir to combine.
Step 7: Simmer for an additional 5 minutes until heated through and flavors meld. Serve warm topped with sour cream and pickled red onions.

t: Goat Cheese and Spinach Scrambled Eggs
d: Start your day with a delightful twist on classic scrambled eggs, featuring creamy goat cheese and fresh spinach. The rich goat cheese adds a tangy depth, while sautéed onions and garlic infuse every bite with savory goodness. Perfectly seasoned, this dish is a breakfast dream that will elevate your morning routine!
dir: In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped spinach and halved cherry tomatoes to the skillet, cooking until the spinach is wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
In a bowl, crack the eggs and whisk until well combined. Pour the eggs into the skillet with the veggies and stir gently to scramble.
As the eggs start to set, add the crumbled goat cheese and continue to stir until the eggs are fully cooked and the cheese is melted, about 3-5 minutes.
If using, sprinkle the shredded pepper jack cheese on top and let it melt slightly.
Serve the scrambled eggs hot, topped with a dollop of sour cream and pickled red onions, or on buttered sourdough bread if you prefer.

d: Transform your sandwiches with this zesty Italian sandwich sauce that bursts with flavor! With roasted garlic, sweet red bell pepper, and a touch of tangy pepperoncini juice, this sauce is a blend of savory and spicy. It brings life to any meal, making your taste buds dance and leaving you craving more!
dir: Start by roasting 4 cloves of garlic, 1 red bell pepper, and 1/2 of a red onion until charred and tender. Let them cool, then chop.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the pepperoncini juice, red vinegar, mayonnaise, lemon juice, yellow mustard, Italian herbs, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Add the roasted garlic, bell pepper, and onion to the sauce mixture, stirring until well incorporated.
Fold in the salami, pepperoni, sun-dried tomatoes, sliced pepperoncini, and pickled red onions until evenly distributed.
If the sauce is too thick, add more mayonnaise, vinegar, or pepperoncini juice until you reach your desired consistency.
Serve this sauce drizzled over sandwiches, or use it as a tasty dip for your favorite snacks.

d: Elevate your condiment game with this rich and creamy homemade mayonnaise made from tallow or butter. Blending raw eggs with zesty lemon juice and Dijon mustard creates a perfect emulsion that's both luscious and satisfying. Perfect for slathering on sandwiches or as a dip, this mayo offers a delightful twist that will have you obsessed!
dir: In a blender, combine the raw eggs, melted tallow or butter, olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, and salt.
Blend on high speed until the mixture is emulsified and creamy, about 30 seconds.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more salt or lemon juice to your liking.
Transfer the mayonnaise to a clean jar and store in the refrigerator.

d: Dive into a vibrant world of flavors with this red creamy chimichurri sauce, packed with roasted red bell peppers and fresh herbs. The smoky sweetness of the peppers combined with zesty lemon juice and fragrant garlic creates an irresistible dip or marinade. It's a bold accompaniment that will elevate any dish to new culinary heights!
i: 1 cup roasted red bell peppers, chopped
dir: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and roast the red bell peppers until charred, about 20-25 minutes. Let them cool and then peel off the skin.
In a mixing bowl, combine the chopped parsley, cilantro, roasted garlic, chopped roasted red bell peppers, and red onion.
Add the olive oil, lemon juice, red wine vinegar, red pepper flakes, and salt to the bowl and mix well.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over low heat, then stir it into the sauce mixture.
Finally, fold in the mayonnaise or sour cream for creaminess. Adjust seasoning to taste.
Serve the sauce with grilled meats, veggies, or as a zesty dip!

d: Warm up with a hearty bowl of chili that's a flavor explosion in every spoonful! Featuring ground beef, diced pork belly, and a medley of fresh vegetables like corn and bell peppers, this dish is both comforting and satisfying. Each bite offers a savory richness, making it the perfect dish for cozy nights or gatherings with friends.
i: 1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained and rinsed
Shredded pepper jack cheese, for serving
dir: In a large pot, brown the ground beef and diced pork belly over medium heat until fully cooked. Drain excess fat.
Add the chopped white and red onions, and minced garlic to the pot. Sauté until the onions are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the corn, bell pepper, diced tomatoes, sauerkraut, kidney beans, chili seasoning, tomato paste, and beef broth. Mix well.
Bring the chili to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and let it cook for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Serve hot, topped with sour cream, shredded pepper jack cheese, chopped green onions, and a side of Fritos.

d: This Garlic Herb Butter is a decadent blend of rich, softened butter infused with roasted garlic and fresh herbs. Key ingredients like aromatic thyme, rosemary, and a splash of lemon juice elevate it to a flavorful experience that’s perfect for spreading on warm bread or melting over grilled steaks. Each bite bursts with a robust, savory flavor that will leave you craving more!
dir: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and roast the garlic for about 30 minutes until soft.
In a mixing bowl, combine the softened butter, chopped parsley, minced roasted garlic, chopped thyme, chopped rosemary, and lemon juice.
Mix everything together until well combined, using a fork or spatula.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding a pinch of salt or more herbs to your liking.
Transfer the garlic herb butter to a piece of parchment paper, roll it into a log, and twist the ends to seal.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to firm up before using, or keep in the freezer for later.

d: Creamy Horseradish Sauce is a zesty condiment combining sour cream and mayonnaise with the bold heat of horseradish. The addition of minced garlic and crisp red onions creates a delightful complexity, while a splash of lemon juice brightens every bite. This sauce adds a fiery kick to any dish, making it an irresistible accompaniment for meats and seafood alike!
dir: In a mixing bowl, combine the sour cream, mayonnaise, horseradish, minced garlic, and chopped red onions.
Add the lemon juice, red wine vinegar, black pepper, and salt to the mixture.
If using, stir in the fresh dill and raw egg for extra creaminess.
Melt the butter in a small saucepan over low heat, then pour it into the sauce mixture.
Mix everything until well combined and smooth.
Taste the sauce and adjust seasoning, adding more salt, pepper, or horseradish as desired.
Refrigerate the sauce for at least 30 minutes before serving to let the flavors meld.

d: Pimping Pasta Salad is a vibrant medley that takes your taste buds on a delightful journey with tri-color rigatoni and orzo. Loaded with shredded pepper jack cheese, roasted garlic, and fresh veggies, this dish is dressed in a light yet tangy vinaigrette. The combination of textures and flavors makes it a perfect side or a light meal that’s both refreshing and satisfying!
i: 1/2 cup Kalamata olives, pitted and sliced
dir: Cook the tri-color rigatoni and tri-color orzo pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and let cool.
While the pasta is cooling, prepare the roasted garlic by removing the cloves from the head and mashing them with a fork.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled pasta, shredded Pepper Jack cheese, crumbled feta, Kalamata olives, red onion, red bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, pepperoni, salami, and fresh basil.
In a separate small bowl, mix together the roasted garlic, Italian seasoning, Italian or Greek dressing, lemon juice, and black pepper.
Pour the dressing mixture over the pasta salad and toss everything together until well coated.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld together.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

d: Fantastic Fried Rice is a colorful stir-fry that brings together day-old basmati rice with an array of fresh vegetables like diced red onions, carrots, and bell peppers. Stir-fried in toasted sesame oil, each ingredient harmonizes beautifully, creating a satisfying crunch and umami flavor. This dish is not only a fantastic way to use leftovers, but it also offers a deliciously addictive experience that will have you coming back for seconds!
dir: In a large skillet or wok, heat the toasted sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add the diced red onion, carrots, and bell peppers. Stir-fry for about 5 minutes until they start to soften.
Stir in the peas, corn, and cucumber, and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the day-old basmati rice, breaking up any clumps, and mix well with the vegetables.
Sprinkle in the chicken bouillon, soy sauce, lemon juice, chili garlic paste, and crispy chili oil. Stir well to combine and heat through, about 5 minutes.
Fold in the roasted garlic and chopped roasted peanuts just before serving.
Top with chopped green onions for garnish and serve hot.

d: Perfect Potato Salad combines tender Yukon Gold potatoes boiled in savory chicken stock with a creamy blend of cream cheese, mayonnaise, and honey mustard vinaigrette. The sharpness of Cheddar cheese adds depth, while the smooth dressing ties it all together. This indulgent side dish is perfect for picnics and barbecues, promising a rich, creamy flavor that delights with every bite!
i: 2 lbs Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and diced
dir: Boil the diced Yukon Gold potatoes in chicken stock until fork-tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain and let cool.
In a large bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, heavy mayonnaise, sour cream, and honey mustard vinaigrette. Mix until smooth.
Add the cooled potatoes to the bowl, along with the Cheddar cheese, red onions, green onions, hard-boiled eggs, sweet relish, celery, crispy bacon, and red bell peppers.
Sprinkle in the red pepper flakes and paprika, and gently fold everything together until well combined.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper as needed.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving to let the flavors meld together.

d: This Sexy Street Corn Salad is a vibrant twist on traditional elote, highlighting charred corn. Key ingredients like smoky chorizo, zesty lime juice, and fresh cilantro elevate its flavor profile. The combination of sweet corn and spicy chorizo creates a mouthwatering balance that will have you craving seconds!
dir: Preheat a grill or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the husked corn and cook, turning occasionally, until lightly charred on all sides, about 10-15 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool.
While the corn is cooling, cook the chorizo in a skillet over medium heat until browned and cooked through, then set aside.
Once the corn is cool enough to handle, cut the kernels off the cob and place them in a large mixing bowl.
Add the red onion, green onion, roasted jalapeño, cilantro, cotija cheese, feta cheese, Parmesan cheese, mayonnaise, sour cream, and lime juice and pulp to the bowl with the corn.
Stir in the cooked chorizo and melted butter, mixing everything together until well combined. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately or chill in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes to let the flavors meld together.

d: Dive into the creamy indulgence of Crazy Mac n Cheese, a comforting pasta dish loaded with cellentani pasta. Enhanced by rich melted cheddar, savory garlic, and sweet red onion, each bite is a delightful explosion of flavor. This mac and cheese is the ultimate cheesy, gooey experience that will elevate any meal into a feast!
i: 1/4 cup chives or green onions, chopped
dir: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
Cook the cellentani pasta according to package instructions until al dente, then drain and set aside.
In a large pot, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and diced red onion, cooking until softened and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the flour and cook for another minute, then gradually add in the sharp cheddar, Parmesan, ricotta, pepper jack, and goat cheese, stirring until melted and creamy.
Add the cooked pasta, sun-dried tomatoes, diced red bell pepper, chopped chives or green onions, crispy mini pepperoni, and crumbled bacon. Mix everything together until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a greased baking dish and top with crushed Cool Ranch Doritos.
Bake in the preheated oven for about 20 minutes, or until bubbly and golden on top. Let it cool for a few minutes before serving.

d: Crispy Asian Chili Mayo is a bold and flavorful condiment that marries creamy mayonnaise with the heat of chili crisp. With minced garlic, chopped shallots, and a touch of sweet Thai chili sauce, this dip packs a punch in every bite. Perfect for drizzling over tacos or as a zesty dip, it’s a must-try for spice lovers!
i: Optional: 1/4 cup Thai sweet chili sauce
dir: In a mixing bowl, combine the chili crisp, mayonnaise, minced garlic, chopped shallots, and sliced green onions.
Mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Add black pepper to taste and stir again.
If you want a touch of sweetness, mix in the Thai sweet chili sauce, if using.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more black pepper or chili crisp for extra heat.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld.

d: Better Cowboy Butter is a luscious compound butter that combines mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, and roasted garlic for an irresistible dip. Infused with fresh herbs like parsley and thyme, along with a kick of smoked paprika, this sauce adds a savory depth to grilled meats and vegetables. Elevate your BBQ game with this flavor-packed spread!
dir: In a mixing bowl, combine the mayonnaise, softened butter, and Dijon mustard until smooth.
Stir in the lemon juice, minced garlic, roasted garlic, and red onion until well mixed.
Add the parsley, thyme, rosemary, smoked paprika, red pepper flakes, and black pepper, mixing until everything is evenly distributed.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more lemon juice or spices to suit your preference.
Transfer the Cowboy Butter to an airtight container and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld together.
Serve chilled or at room temperature as a spread for grilled meats, veggies, or bread.

d: Cilantro Lime Sauce is a zesty and creamy dressing that brings freshness to any dish, featuring a blend of mayonnaise and Greek yogurt. With bright lime juice and fragrant cilantro, it offers a tangy kick that perfectly complements tacos, grilled chicken, or salads. This sauce is a vibrant addition that will awaken your taste buds!
dir: In a medium bowl, combine the mayonnaise and Greek yogurt until smooth.
Add the chopped cilantro, minced garlic, lime juice, salt, and pepper to the bowl.
Stir the mixture until all ingredients are well combined.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more salt or lime juice to your liking.
Transfer the sauce to a serving dish or store in an airtight container in the refrigerator until ready to use.

d: This Special Steak Sauce elevates your favorite cuts with a rich blend of A1 Sauce, roasted garlic, and sautéed shallots. The tangy depth from red bell pepper and onion adds a vibrant kick that complements meat perfectly. Drizzle it on your steak for a mouthwatering explosion of flavors that will leave you craving more!
i: 1/4 cup gravy and fat from cooked steak
dir: In a skillet over medium heat, melt the butter and sauté the minced shallots until they're translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the roasted and charred garlic, red bell pepper, and red onion to the skillet and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
In a mixing bowl, combine the sautéed mixture with A1 Sauce, mayonnaise, pepperoncini juice, lemon juice, gravy and fat from the steak, and beef bouillon.
If using, add Dijon mustard, horseradish, and minced jalapeno to the bowl and mix well.
Stir in fresh thyme, parsley, rosemary, salt, and coarse black pepper.
Simmer the sauce over low heat for about 10-15 minutes to let the flavors meld together.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed before serving it warm over your favorite steak.

d: Ranch Sauce is a creamy, tangy dip made with a luscious mixture of mayonnaise, sour cream, and heavy cream. The addition of ranch seasoning, paprika, and fresh herbs like dill creates an irresistible flavor profile. Perfect for dipping veggies or slathering on sandwiches, this sauce is sure to be a crowd-pleaser at any gathering!
dir: In a medium bowl, combine the mayonnaise, sour cream, and heavy cream until smooth.
Add the ranch seasoning mix, dried dill, paprika, salt, pepper, grated garlic, dehydrated red onion, and dehydrated cucumber to the bowl.
Stir everything together until well combined.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld.
Before serving, taste and adjust the seasoning if needed.

d: Creamy Al Pastor Sauce is a vibrant, spiced sauce featuring sautéed red onions and garlic, combined with rich guajillo chiles and adobo sauce. The fragrant oregano brings everything together, making it the perfect topping for tacos or grilled meats. Its bold flavors will transport your taste buds straight to a Mexican street food paradise!
i: 2 dried guajillo chiles, seeds removed and chopped
dir: In a skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and add the diced red onion and minced garlic. Sauté until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped guajillo chiles, ancho chile paste, adobo sauce, and oregano to the skillet. Stir and cook for another 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
In a mixing bowl, combine the sour cream, pork bouillon, orange juice, diced pineapple, and the sautéed mixture from the skillet. Stir until well combined.
Add the chopped cilantro and cotija cheese, mixing gently to combine. Adjust seasoning to taste.
Simmer the sauce over low heat for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally to blend the flavors.
Serve warm over tacos, grilled meats, or as a dip!

d: Get ready for a flavor explosion with Habenareo Pizza Ranch Aoli, a spicy twist on the classic ranch sauce. This zesty concoction combines mayonnaise, sour cream, and minced garlic with the fiery kick of Habenareo pepper and savory pepperoni. Perfect for drizzling over pizza or as a bold dipping sauce, it will ignite your culinary creativity!
i: 1 orange bell pepper, roasted and chopped
dir: In a medium bowl, combine the mayonnaise, sour cream, dill, ranch seasoning mix, minced garlic, chopped Habenareo pepper, diced pepperoni, and black pepper.
Mix well until all the ingredients are thoroughly combined.
In a small skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the roasted orange bell pepper and red onion to the skillet and sauté for about 5 minutes until warmed through.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly, then fold the roasted veggies into the aioli mixture.
Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary, adding more ranch seasoning or black pepper as desired.
Serve immediately or chill in the refrigerator until ready to use.

d: Mexican Street Corn Sauce is a creamy, zesty blend that captures the essence of elote in every bite. With Cotija and Fresco cheese, roasted corn, and a hint of lime juice, this sauce is rich and refreshing. It's the ultimate topping for tacos, grilled meats, or simply as a dip, bringing the street food experience right to your kitchen!
i: 1 tablespoon chili lime seasoning or Tajín
dir: In a skillet over medium heat, cook the chorizo until browned and crumbly. Remove from heat and set aside.

In a large bowl, combine the Cotija cheese, Fresco cheese, mayonnaise, sour cream, yogurt, lime juice, chili lime seasoning, taco seasoning, roasted corn, roasted red peppers, red onion, garlic, and jalapeño.
Add the cooked chorizo to the mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the sauce to a saucepan and heat over low heat for about 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally until warmed through.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, adding more lime juice or seasoning if desired.
Serve warm as a dip with tortilla chips or as a topping for tacos, grilled meats, or veggies.

d: Marry Me Chicken sauce is a luscious blend of flavors that elevates any dish to romantic heights. With sun-dried tomatoes, zesty lemon juice, and a splash of white wine, this sauce tantalizes the palate while the buttery goodness brings it all together. It's a delightful way to impress your loved ones and make every meal feel special!
i: 1 tablespoon stone ground mustard or whole grain mustard seed (optional)
dir: In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook until soft, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic, chopped green onions, and diced red bell pepper. Cook for another 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the sun-dried tomatoes, lemon juice, and white wine to the skillet, scraping up any browned bits on the bottom. Simmer for about 5 minutes.
Pour in the chicken stock and heavy cream, then add the chicken bouillon, cayenne pepper, smoked paprika, Italian herbs, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, then reduce heat to low and stir in the chopped basil and grated Parmesan cheese. Cook for another 5 minutes until the sauce thickens.
If using, stir in the stone ground mustard for an extra kick. Adjust seasoning to taste.
Serve the sauce over cooked chicken, pasta, or rice, and enjoy!

d: This Goat Cheese Chaluah Hot Sauce is a creamy, spicy dip that packs a punch. Infused with robust Chalua hot sauce, roasted garlic, and zesty green chilies, it’s a flavor explosion that enhances everything from tacos to grilled meats. Whip it up for your next gathering and watch it disappear in a flash!
i: 2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, minced
dir: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Roast the garlic by wrapping it in foil and placing it in the oven for about 30 minutes until soft.
In a mixing bowl, combine the softened goat cheese and cream cheese until smooth.
Add the Chalua hot sauce, green chilies, chipotle peppers, serrano peppers, roasted garlic (squeezed out of their skins), olive oil, butter, and lemon juice to the bowl. Mix well.
Stir in the thyme, rosemary, oregano, black pepper, and salt until everything is well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a small saucepan and heat over medium-low heat for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until warmed through.
Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary, adding more salt or hot sauce as desired.
Serve warm as a dip or drizzle over your favorite dishes.

d: The Buffalo Chicken Cream Cheese Sauce is a velvety blend that brings all the classic flavors of buffalo wings to your table. With the kick of Red Hot hot sauce, creamy melted cream cheese, and savory roasted garlic, it's a dip that satisfies cravings in every bite. Perfect for game day or cozy gatherings, it’s an irresistible treat!
dir: In a skillet over medium heat, melt the butter.
Add the roasted garlic, red onion, and red bell pepper to the skillet and sauté until the vegetables are soft, about 5 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low, then stir in the cream cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the Red Hot hot sauce, chicken tomato bouillon, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until fully combined.
Let the sauce simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed, adding more salt or hot sauce to your preference.
Serve warm as a dip or over chicken, pasta, or veggies.

d: Magical Marry Me Chicken is a delectable dish that transforms ordinary chicken thighs into culinary magic. Encrusted with a fragrant blend of garlic salt, Italian seasoning, and zesty lemon zest, and sautéed to perfection, each bite is bursting with flavor. This dish is not just a meal; it’s a heartfelt experience that’s sure to win over anyone’s heart!
i: 1 tablespoon stone ground mustard or whole grain mustard seed
dir: In a large bowl, combine the flour, potato or corn starch, cayenne pepper, garlic salt, Italian seasoning, lemon zest, and black pepper. Dredge the chicken thighs in this mixture, then dip in the beaten eggs.
In a large skillet, heat a mix of butter and avocado oil over medium heat. Add the chicken thighs and cook until golden brown on both sides, about 5-7 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the chopped bacon (if using) and cook until crispy. Add the onions, garlic, and red bell pepper, cooking until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, chicken stock, white wine, lemon juice, and chicken bouillon. Bring to a simmer, then add the heavy cream and smoked paprika. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet, cover, and let it simmer on low for about 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Meanwhile, cook the angel hair pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Stir in the chopped basil and grated Parmesan cheese into the sauce. Adjust seasoning with black pepper as needed.
Serve the chicken and sauce over the angel hair pasta and with garlic bread on the side.
